eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 6:12 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 12:12 PM JUL 26, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office is searching for a missing backpacker, James Roger Carol, 77 years old, white male, 5 ft 8 inches tall, 160 pounds, white beard and dark clothing. Carol is last known to be in the area of Duck Lakes or High Lake area of the Russian Wilderness. If seen, call SCSO at 530-841-2900
